comment: Source-of-truth for widget metadata across firmware, desktop, web editor, marketplace. Codegen target: WIDGET_DEFS JS literal in main/web/index.html (and synced copies). See schema/README.md.

fields.name: anchor_enabled
fields.label: Anchor Curve
fields._doc:
Anchor-based non-linear scale. "Pin THIS data value to
THIS position on the bar" - splits the range into two
linear segments. e.g. coolant 0-110, anchor=90,
position=50 makes 0-90 cover the first half, 90-110
cover the second half. anchor_enabled=false (default)
= pure linear.

fields.name: fill_edge_width
fields.label: Leading Edge Width
fields.help: Bright marker that rides the fill's leading edge (current value), like the path-bar tach. Works on colour and image fills. 0 = off.

fields.name: image_scale
fields.label: Image Scale %
fields._doc:
Zoom for the alert image (100 = native), centred on the widget.
Only applies in image mode (ignored for the plain circle lamp).

fields.name: start_angle_user
fields.label: Start Angle (°)
fields._doc:
User-coord start angle: 0° = 12 o'clock, CW positive.
_meterSyncDerived translates this into the LVGL
start_angle/end_angle pair the firmware reads.

fields.name: anchor_enabled
fields.label: Anchor Curve
fields._doc:
Anchor-based non-linear scale. "Pin THIS data value
to THIS position on the sweep" - splits the range into
two linear segments. e.g. anchor=90, position=50 makes
0-90 cover the first half of the sweep, 90-max the
second half. anchor_enabled=false (default) = linear.

fields.name: minor_tick_step
fields.label: Minor Tick Value Spacing
fields._doc:
auto_ticks lives in w.config but is NOT in the inspector
- see _meterSyncDerived. Min/Major Tick Spacing replace
the old count-based fields.

fields.name: mid_tick_step
fields.label: Medium Tick Value Spacing
fields._doc:
Optional 3rd tick tier between minor and major. Value spacing
in data units (e.g. 500 = a medium tick every 500 RPM). 0 = off.

fields.name: redline_enabled
fields.label: Redline
fields._doc:
Redline zone: visual cues drawn between threshold and
max. Show Arc + Recolor Ticks default ON so enabling
the master toggle gives an immediate visible result.

fields.name: tick_label_divisor
fields.label: Tick Label Divisor
fields._doc:
Divides each tick label by this factor — e.g. 1000 turns a
0..7000 tach into 0..7 (print the unit elsewhere, "RPM x1000").

fields.name: show_needle
fields.label: Show Needle
fields._doc:
Master toggle for the value needle. When off, the meter
renders ticks / labels / ball only — no needle line, image,
or needle shadow. Independent of Show Needle Ball.

fields.name: needle_tip_base_w
fields.label: Tip Base Width
fields._doc:
Tip-tuning knobs. Stored value 0 = "use the built-in
default for the current style". `autoFn` returns the
resolved default the firmware would pick - mirrors the
same defaults used in widget_meter.c's DRAW_PART hook
so the inspector can show the effective number even
when the user hasn't entered an explicit override.

fields.name: show_needle_ball
fields.label: Show Needle Ball
fields._doc:
Toggle the center pivot ball. When off, the ball is hidden
regardless of size. Independent of Show Needle.

fields.name: anchor_enabled
fields.label: Anchor Curve
fields._doc:
Anchor-based non-linear scale. "Pin THIS data value to
THIS position on the bar" - splits the range into two
linear segments. e.g. coolant 0-110, anchor=90,
position=50 makes 0-90 cover the first half, 90-110
cover the second half. anchor_enabled=false (default)
= pure linear.

fields.name: fade_fill
fields.label: Fade Fill
fields.help: Dim-to-bright gradient along the lit arc (positional, redraw-cheap).

fields.name: lead_edge_enabled
fields.label: Leading Edge
fields.help: Bright marker at the current-value end of the fill.

fields.name: fade_fill
fields.label: Fade Fill
fields.help: Dim-to-bright gradient along the lit band (positional, redraw-cheap).

fields.name: lead_edge_enabled
fields.label: Leading Edge
fields.help: Bright flat marker at the current-value tip of the fill.

fields.name: shape
fields.label: Shape
fields.help: Preset shapes (L-Bend / Straight / 45° / J-Hook) are generated to fit the widget box — no path to draw. J-Hook is the Ford digital-tach curve: a swept arc into a horizontal run, perfect every time. Choose Custom to hand-draw your own path.

fields.name: hook_angle
fields.label: Hook Sweep
fields.help: J-Hook only: the arc sweep in degrees (meter-style). 90 = quarter circle (vertical at the start), 180 = half circle. The radius auto-fits the box height and the curve always meets the straight bar tangentially — a perfect circular radius, never skewed.

fields.name: smooth
fields.label: Smooth Curve
fields.help: Custom paths only: treat the path points as a few anchors and fit a smooth Catmull-Rom curve through them (no need to hand-place dozens of points).

fields.name: show_ticks
fields.label: Show Scale
fields._doc:
Draw a tick + number scale that FOLLOWS the path (spaced by
arc-length so the marks line up with the fill). Turns a bare
pathbar into a Ford-style swept tach.

fields.name: tick_label_divisor
fields.label: Number Divisor
fields._doc:
Divides each number by this factor — e.g. 1000 turns a
0..8000 tach into 0..8 (print the unit elsewhere).
